top_choice_rationale: P001 awards Katori and Ye for the invention and realization of optical lattice clocks. The magic-wavelength idea is a distinct, mature achievement from the comb (2005) and trapped-ion control (2012) prizes, it has been confirmed at the 1e-18 level by several independent laboratories, and the two-name allocation needs no arbitrary cut. A prize here is clearly preferable to no award.
